inv.desc_en:
Excellent opportunity to acquire a fully operational business in one of Madrid's very family-friendly areas.

Located on Paseo de San Illán, the premises enjoy a strategic location surrounded by homes, offices, educational centers, and a wide range of commercial activity, guaranteeing a constant flow of potential customers throughout the year.

The business is currently operational and ready to continue its activity from day one, offering a magnificent opportunity for both entrepreneurs and investors looking for a location with great visibility and potential.

The excellent public transport links, the high population density of the area, and the constant pedestrian traffic make this location an ideal enclave for developing and boosting any commercial activity.

For more information about the business, economic conditions, and to arrange a visit, please do not hesitate to contact us.

NOTE: This advertisement is not binding, is shown for informational purposes, and may contain errors.
